exact_statement: For every Boolean phase c on a three-bit shared uniform cube (c may ignore coordinates), three distinct shared rows, arbitrary possibly correlated events E0,E1,E2 on one independent finite private cube, and fresh selector z, set G=c,H=c(1-2 sum_j 1_row_j 1_Ej),F=mux_z(G,H),qj=Pr(Ej),d=sum qj/8,delta=sum qj^2/8,a=Fourier(c),b=Fourier(c sum_j qj 1_row_j). Exactly B_z=2(d-delta)+sum Phi((a-b)^2,b^2), and for ALL real q in[0,1]^3, B_z<4d for d>0, with B_z=0 at d=0. The complete entropy surcharge is at most Kd,K=4+2/ln2<7. Supplied normalized positive-support child references, calibrated on shared-only atoms while preserving the full private conditional reference, yield one normalized parent reference with D_F=D_Hcal/2 and CE_F=average calibrated child CE+Delta; actual I_F=average original physical child I+d. No private event independence or opaque terminal certification is assumed. A general finite-dimensional entropy-tangent lemma supplies convex quadratic upper bounds for B-4d with maxima at box corners; all16 phase representatives have exact complete probability-cube certificates independently reproduced with Fraction logarithms. Adding the three-row node to the v4 literal/constant certificate grammar, with BOTH actual children already certified, preserves CE<=KI, physical restriction heredity, disjoint tensors, fresh balancing and point activation, and reflects membership from rare activated balanced tensors to their original seed. The five-bit at-least-two sign remains outside this grammar. Four-to-eight independently varying shared rows, both-private middle-band branches, growing-overlap payment and full FEI remain open.
